description: This file contains the implementation of Azure Blob storage lease provider, managing leasing operations (acquire, renew, release) on blobs for distributed systems, including initialization, error handling, and delegation to Azure SDK components.

classes.name: AzureBlobLeaseProvider
classes.description: Implements ILeaseProvider for managing blob leases in Azure Storage, providing methods to acquire, release, and renew leases asynchronously.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Acquires leases for a batch of lease requests on specified categories and resource keys.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Helper method to acquire a lease on a specific resource key and category, creating the blob if it does not exist.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases a set of acquired leases.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Helper method to release a specific acquired lease.

methods.name: Renew
methods.description: Renews a set of acquired leases.

methods.name: Renew
methods.description: Helper method to renew a specific acquired lease.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate an AzureBlobLeaseProvider with named options.

methods.name: InitContainerIfNotExistsAsync
methods.description: Initializes the blob container if it hasn't been initialized.

methods.name: GetBlobClient
methods.description: Constructs a BlobClient for a specific resource key within a category.
